'''Huff Darklighter's personal security force''' was a private security force created by [[Huff Darklighter]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Some members wore [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]] which was stained [[Color/Legends|dark blue]] to match the color of their uniforms.<ref name="X-Wing: The Bacta War" />

In [[7 ABY/Legends|7.5 ABY]],<ref name="New Essential Chronology" /> former members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] wore the security force's variant of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] armor – which they had procured from Huff – during an operation on [[Elshandruu Pica]], as part of the [[Bacta War]].<ref name="X-Wing: The Bacta War" />
